retained_findings.finding: The condition tests only pull-request-number. It does not establish a newly created PR; retain the narrower claim that auto-merge is attempted when a PR number is reported. No action implementation was executed or presumed. The synchronization workflow is docs-internal-only, scheduled on weekdays and manually dispatchable. Write permissions, bot-token use, pinned actions, automated approval/auto-merge, concurrency, and failure routing describe this upstream pipeline, not a locally authorized rollout or independent review.

The fixture enumerates headings in main content and checks depth. It does not filter visible headings or assert their visibility; remove visible from the claim rather than promoting the test into rendered evidence. Playwright fixtures describe keyboard, width, heading, naming, row-header, narrow-view, and contrast expectations. They were inspected inertly, not executed; fixture assertions are not all-version accessibility certification.

The cited source says Secret type can be used to report on secrets from specific issuers. It does not establish a REST filtering predicate; retain issuer-reporting context without claiming query-filter behavior. The support reference separates category capabilities, plan/feature gates, precision estimates, token versions, and generated UI dependencies. Generic validity and password blocking/validity are unsupported; provider support is partial. Table facts here are reused context and do not add provider-cell review credit.
